prompt: Long lens at shoulder height, as if from inside a torch-lit crowd of 1920s strikers at the iron gates of a mill. A wild-eyed Greek American dockworker of about 28, heavy black brows, curly hair, big square stubbled jaw, torn work shirt, faces us three-quarter, sharp in a soft sea of flat caps, head high, singing with his teeth bared. Out of focus behind him, torches smear gold, a black 1920s sedan lies on its roof, and petrol-blue smoke rolls through. His face catches a torch from just off frame, gold on the mouth, blue in the shadow side. Nobody's arm or tool crosses his face. Full frame, no bars. Thanks.
